mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) compress the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in payroll growth indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising >0.25% over 3 months) increase cost of capital and depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST above 550,000 units) indicate robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 550,000 units (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDP growth slowing but positive), strong retail sales (RSAFS above 350,000 million dollars) signal resilient consumer demand that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions with RSAFS above 350,000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST below 550,000) and industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals broad economic slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).
